finalText:
**Big but bounded: 94 files hit, 77 safe to touch.**

75 service files rename freely. Four zones must not.

| Zone | Files | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `migrations/` | 12 | Applied history. A rename needs a new migration. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 4 | `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites edits. |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 1 | Public contract. Renaming breaks every client. |
| `lib/serialize.js` | 1 | Right side of `WIRE` is the public key. |

The SQL column stays `account_id` in every repo query. Only the JS names change.
